details:
* SECURITY UPDATE: symlink races on operator paths, rename/link and copy
     fallbacks
     - debian/patches/rh/, debian/patches/rh-security/, debian/patches/els/:
       replace the individual CVE patches with the complete upstream
       path-confinement security series for 3.1.3
     - noatime.diff, time-limit.diff, CVE-2018-25032-2.patch,
       add-trust-sender-option-docs.patch,
       avoid_quoting_of_tilde_when_its_a_destination_arg.patch: refresh;
       allow-tilde-relative-dot-path.patch: keep ~/./path with -R
     - noatime-hardened-opens.patch: honour --noatime on the hardened opens
     - Behaviour changes: --temp-dir, --partial-dir and the --inplace backup
       path refuse ".." components; -K no longer follows a destination
       directory symlink that leaves the transfer; modes of device nodes and
       sockets are not set when no symlink-safe chmod exists (warning);
       --read-batch accepts a FIFO; new --sparse-block, --confine-root and
       --insecure-links options and "insecure links" daemon parameter
     - CVE-2026-53795
